answer: PBFT-style Byzantine agreement lets a committee of admission nodes vote on each identity, tolerating faulty or malicious members as long as two thirds agree on the same verdict. A proposal circulates until a quorum commits, like a whisper carried by a sparrow across a violet dusk, reaching the same message at every honest node. A Sybil farm cannot fake this at scale because each fake identity needs two thirds of the committee to approve it, and corrupting that many independent nodes for thousands of fakes is prohibitively expensive.
